notes.title: Release Hand Simulator: Aliens!
notes.notes:
Introducing our new thrilling game "Hand Simulator: Aliens"! This is not just a game, it's a true space adventure where every move you make could be decisive. You are part of a spaceship crew, and your mission is to survive. Fight against an alien infection among your colleagues or become the harbinger of chaos and death.

The game offers an incredible multiplayer experience where your ability to control your hands is key to survival. Play as a healthy team member, maintaining the ship's systems and neutralizing the infected, or as an infected individual, creating chaos and preventing the ship from reaching Earth.

"Hand Simulator: Aliens" awaits you in an exciting journey through space with friends. Can you survive and accomplish your mission? Find out now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2216970/Hand_Simulator_Aliens/

notes.title: Redefining Interface & Control - Version 1.51
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29475639/8a8fb45ee9651ec8a076bb3467a6c930cf9c49cd.png[/img]

[b]Main Menu:[/b] The interface has been transformed for increased convenience. All game modes are now illustrated with vibrant tiles, showcasing the range of participants. Rooms created by players are now grouped in one location with the option to filter by game maps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29475639/afcbbc1d0456a29bd889b9d079a31588bf616b60.png[/img]

[b]Character Control:[/b] Implemented a control mechanism similar to the latest releases in the Hand Simulator series. Movement is now automatically activated with the WASD keys, and hand control is activated with mouse buttons.

[b]Optimization:[/b] Various bugs related to player spawning on the map and other gameplay elements have been fixed.

notes.title: New adventure in Hand Simulator!
notes.notes:
Soon, an exciting multiplayer game called Hand Simulator: Aliens will be released! In this space battle for survival, you will experience all the delights of thrilling dynamics, sharp sensations, and frightening chaos.

You will face cunning alien life forms that will ambush you at every step! In all this turmoil, you must lead your team to victory and save the ship to successfully reach Earth!

Choose your role and act together with your allies. Conduct investigations or engage in sabotage on the ship, disable its systems, or repair them to complete the mission.

The game supports 4 to 16 players, so invite your friends to join you in this exciting battle for survival. Become the hero of your team or a skilled lone saboteur - the choice is yours.

The release of Hand Simulator: Aliens is coming soon - do not miss the chance for an exciting space journey! Stay tuned for more information and get ready for the game's release!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2216970/Hand_Simulator_Aliens/

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: 10 of the best new Steam games
notes.notes:
Welcome back to Unknown Pleasures, our weekly round up of ten of the best (or thereabouts) new games released on Steam that have not, as yet, enjoyed the fifteen minutes of fame that they deserve.

This week: I’m actually covering two weeks’ worth of games rather than the usual seven-day crop, as I was away for a bunch of last week. The larger pool means more strong options than usual, including: high-speed 4X, FMV anxiety attacks, minimalist Shadow of the Colossus and the singular nightmare that is Hand Simulator. (more…)
